title: Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million A person familiar with the matter said Gemini sold its already shuttered U.K. and European operations to Singapore payments firm KAST for less than $10 million, hours before the exchange reports third-quarter results. Gemini declined to comment. This post Crypto Exchange Gemini Sells U.K. and EU Units to KAST for Under $10 Million first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
